summary: Full backend + frontend test of Slicer Companion. 13/13 pytest tests PASS. Frontend loads on mobile viewport (390x844), all 5 tabs render, seed data verified in UI (5 printer cards, 4 filament rows), Add Printer & Add Filament modals open with save buttons, theme toggle present in Settings, Slicer tab renders with slice-btn, Workspace shows Upload STL button.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: route ordering is fine (GET /printers/discover is distinct method from /printers/{id} PATCH/DELETE). No conflicts.
server.py uses @app.on_event which is deprecated in newer FastAPI. Consider lifespan handlers. Not blocking.
Slicing rotation is intentionally omitted (documented). OK for MVP.
All list endpoints correctly exclude Mongo _id via projection {'_id': 0}.
server.py is ~630 lines, close to the 700 line threshold. Consider splitting routers (models/printers/filaments/slicing) if it grows further.
seed_data_creation: None created. Test-only printers/filaments were fully cleaned up (create → patch → delete flow).
